maria_cs: Quick ops pulse for CalderEdge (private/VPC) — TL;DR below. Looping SRE + KMS.
- Usage: +12% w/w, embedding calls concentrated in eu-west1.
- Latency: ap-southeast1 p95 ~2.1s since Wed, p99 spikes to 3.6s.
- Uptime: eu-west1 brief reconnects, overall ~99.88% for the week.
- KMS: 2 HSM auth failures in eu-west1 (Mon); both nodes recovered, but audit shows repeated 403s for one service account.
- Spend: committed capacity burn at ~78%; if usage keeps growing we hit overage in 3 weeks.
Planning: customer enablement call Thu 11am PT. Any immediate blockers?

raj_sre: seeing the ap-southeast tail too. Traces show a few long queues around the autoscale boundary. I opened a trace: https://traces.internal/trace/abc123 — looks like batching backed up at the gateway.

alex_eng: can you paste the small sample span? wondering if KV cache miss rate went up after last rollout.

raj_sre: sample span snippet: `span_id=0x7f9c, queue_wait_ms=420, batch_size=1, model="redwood-v1-q"` — lots of size=1 requests. Might be client-side retry pattern.

alex_eng: hmm — we pushed a tiny timeout change to the SDK last week that could cause earlier retries. I'll grep the release log.

kms-bot: ALERT: 2026-03-16 09:14 UTC — 2 HSM auth failures in eu-west1 detected. Ticket created: CS-4821.

maria_cs: thanks — raj, please own ap-southeast1 triage. Alex, can you verify SDK rollout impact? Jenna, I'll need a renewal-risk blurb if spend trend continues.

raj_sre: taking ap-southeast1. Running a short perf job now and will post latency flamegraph. Command I'm running: `./diag.sh --region ap-southeast1 --since 2026-03-18 --samples 500`

alex_eng: confirmed — SDK edge timeout bumped from 250ms -> 180ms in release 1.4.7; clients that retried on timeout would create more small requests. Rolling a patch to revert the tweak to canary.

jenna_pm: noted on renewal risk. Draft blurb for account team: "Usage growth positive but uneven across regions; potential short-term overage risk if ap-southeast1 latency persists and drives retries. Recommend temporary burst cap increase or adjusting client retries before renewal conversation." Will share in the renewal doc by EOD.

calder_ops: FYI — customer reported a short interruption Monday around 09:10 UTC; they saw a few 503s and retried. They asked if we could enable a safemode to throttle client retries while you investigate.

raj_sre: understood. I'll add an automated prefix-caching rule and short circuit small requests — should reduce gateway queue pressure. Patch ETA ~45m.

maria_cs: great. For KMS: Alex, could you coordinate with security to rotate the service account keys for that one SA and check HSM auth logs? If rotation is heavy, we'll notify the customer window.

alex_eng: on it. Creating ticket SEC-1109 for SA rotation and audit.

maria_cs: I'll update the shared account doc with current numbers and schedule Thu enablement call invite. Also flagging this as medium renewal risk unless we stabilize spend/latency.

raj_sre: posted perf flamegraph: https://internal.artifacts/perf/fe/2134567890/flamegraph.svg — initial look: 60% queue time at gateway, not model.

jenna_pm: thanks team. I'll prepare slides for Thu call focusing on mitigation (retry config, temporary burst, KMS rotation plan).

calder_ops: customer prefers Thu 11am PT. They want a short mitigation checklist to share with their infra team ahead of the call.

maria_cs: I'll send the checklist (3 bullets) and the invite. Closing notes: raj will monitor ap-southeast1 and confirm reduction in small-request rate after gateway fix; alex will coordinate SA rotation; jenna will own renewal blurb and customer slides. :thumbsup:

raj_sre: will post follow-ups here when gateway patch is in prod.

alex_eng: posting SEC ticket link and will ping KMS team.

kms-bot: UPDATE: Ticket CS-4821 status -> investigating (assigned to kms-team).

maria_cs: thanks all — back in this thread with updates.
